newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady bids on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady bids on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the exchange said.
No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- One barge, Mid-Mississippi River, this week, bid 145 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, Lacrose-Savage, upper Mississippi, bid 170 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of April, bid 140 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of May, bid 125 percent, unchanged from Thursday, offered 130 percent.
- Five barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of June, no bid, offered 130 percent.
